title: Neurosurgeon dies as volvo swerves across lanes, hits barrier, erupts into flames
content: A senior neurosurgeon died when his car caught fire on the Hyderabad-Khammam highway.  The vehicle veered across lanes and crashed into a barrier before igniting.  CCTV footage captured the tragic moments leading up to the fatal accident early Sunday.  Investigators are examining sleep deprivation and potential technical faults as causes.  The doctor was traveling to Hyderabad where his family resides.

title: Why Suchika Tariyal lost despite a draw: Final denied by 700g, left her in tears
content: Suchika Tariyal has made history by winning India's first bronze medal in MMA at the Asian Games. Her semifinal bout ended in a draw, with the outcome determined by a minuscule weight difference. Tariyal's journey into combat sports was sparked by a self-defense incident at the age of twelve. This significant achievement symbolises a milestone for Indian combat sports on an international stage.

title: Oracle layoffs reach 'flagship' data center that it shows as proof OpenAI deal is fine
content: Oracle layoffs have reached Abilene, Texas, the flagship Stargate data center Oracle cites as proof its OpenAI deal is on track. One OCI employee said on r/employeesOfOracle that he learnt he was fired only when his badge failed at the gate. Oracle severance is four weeks' pay plus a week per year served. Slack counts fell by about 3,200 as US cuts hit OCI, Fusion, NetSuite and Oracle Health.

title: 'Exercise Tarang Shakti is back': IAF announces resumption of multinational air exercise
content: Jodhpur will host India's renowned multinational air exercise, Tarang Shakti, gathering global air forces for collaborative aerial operations and tactical training. Building on the momentum from the India-Japan air combat exercise Veer Guardian, this event will facilitate the exchange of operational practices and execution of intricate aerial missions. The primary objective is to enhance interoperability and deepen understanding of various operational protocols.

title: 4 men putting up CCTV cams in Delhi die as dumper hits crane
content: A tragic incident occurred early Sunday morning when a dumper truck crashed into a stationary crane, resulting in the death of four workers who were installing CCTV cameras. Two additional workers were injured in the accident. The truck driver fled the scene and remains on the loose. Families have expressed concerns about insufficient safety measures in the workplace, prompting police to intensify their search for the driver.

content: The landlord had relied on his purchase of the plot in 2012. However, he failed to establish the legally relevant completion date through the completion intimation or property-tax assessment required under the Act. The Rent Controller had also not made a specific finding on this issue.

title: Denver bank building got $22.4m renovation; now it is 100% vacant
content: Denver’s historic Vault building, bought for $17.6 million in 2017, remains completely vacant despite a $22.4 million renovation. The 107,630-square-foot former bank building once housed WeWork, which left in 2021. With downtown office vacancies still high, the 119-year-old property is now being offered for office use, adaptive reuse, residential conversion or hospitality.

title: Bill Gates ex-wife reveals why she didn’t fund daughter's startup
content: Melinda French Gates did not fund her daughter Phoebe's startup venture. She wanted Phoebe to experience the fundraising process independently and learn resilience. This approach mirrors Bill Gates' philosophy on inheritance for their children. Phoebe Gates launched a fashion-tech startup called Phia shopping app. French Gates believes rejection builds courage for female founders.

title: Drums, music and band greet gangster as he reaches village for naming twin daughters
content: Gangster Sandeep alias Kala Jathedi attended his twin daughters' naming ceremony on parole. He was brought from Tihar Jail to his native Jathedi village under tight security. His wife Anuradha Chaudhary had sought custody parole for these important family rituals. The twins were born through IVF, and extensive security was arranged for the visit. After the ceremonies, Delhi Police returned Jathedi to Tihar Jail.

title: Ed Sheeran says friends and family ‘abandoned’ him amid Macklemore controversy
content: Ed Sheeran performed emotionally in Philadelphia after opening acts withdrew.  He expressed feeling abandoned by friends and family during the tour.  Sheeran acknowledged changing the stage layout due to security concerns.  The singer stated he continued performing for his dedicated fans.  This concert followed controversy over Macklemore's removal from the tour.

title: Jest to be called 'papa' turns into row, leads to stabbing death of Delhi teen
content: A joking demand for respect led to a fatal stabbing in Naraina Village.  An 18-year-old boy died after being stabbed during a heated argument.  The incident occurred when acquaintances met on a motorcycle late Saturday night.  One acquaintance pulled out a knife and threatened another person.  Police have registered a murder case and are investigating the sequence of events.

title: Pakistan airstrike kills 3 in Afghanistan, Taliban warns of ‘crushing response’

The latest escalation comes days after the Taliban warned that it would defend Afghan territory against any Pakistani military action. In an interview with Al Arabiya English, Mujahid rejected Pakistan's allegations that militant groups based in Afghanistan recruit, train and launch attacks against Pakistan.

title: Why Trump’s $24.3 billion Saudi F-35 deal is raising concerns in US, Israel
content: The proposed $24.3 billion sale of F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia is under careful examination. If approved, this transaction would position Saudi Arabia as the second country in the Middle East to acquire these high-tech military aircraft. However, apprehensions about the impact on regional military dynamics and Israel's strategic advantage loom large. Moreover, the growing relationship between Saudi Arabia and China raises further concerns regarding technology security.

title: In 2022, Tom Hanks launched his own nonprofit coffee brand for war veterans

This brand channels every profit towards vital veteran services, offering a diverse range of coffee blends. With his longstanding commitment to philanthropy, Hanks continues to uplift communities and provide essential resources such as employment assistance for veterans.

title: Allahabad HC rejects heirs’ land plea after 22 years, says state took possession in 1992
content: The Allahabad high court dismissed a family's land restoration plea filed after twenty-two years.  The court found the family had not challenged dispossession within a reasonable time.  Proceedings under the Urban Land Ceiling Act were completed in 1992.  The family failed to prove possession when the Repeal Act came into force.  Unexplained delay meant the plea could not be considered by the court.

title: How Jordon Hudson became an important part of Bill Belichick’s life

During a 2025 interview, he praised Hudson as “terrific” and “very helpful,” explaining that she supported him with business matters and his book while he focused on coaching at North Carolina. His remarks offered a glimpse into their relationship, emphasizing companionship, trust, support, and mutual perspective.

title: Michael Jordan’s high school rejection before becoming an NBA legend
content: Michael Jordan’s journey to six NBA championships began with a high school setback when he failed to make the varsity team as a sophomore. Instead of giving up, he used the rejection as motivation to improve. His relentless work ethic propelled him from college basketball to NBA superstardom, where he led the Chicago Bulls to six titles and became one of the greatest players in basketball history.

title: Mumbai student alleges home search after pro-Palestine campaign

title: AfD tops another German state poll, Merz’s CDU crashes to historic low

title: Dutch scientists find tin-based solar breakthrough keeping hot electrons 1,000x longer
content: tin-based perovskite materials allow hot electrons to retain their excess energy for around 1,000 times longer than expected . two physical effects work together to slow electron cooling from picoseconds to nanoseconds . findings could support the development of hot-carrier solar cells designed to reduce thermalisation losses and improve solar conversion efficiency .

title: Congress takes 'Kya hua tera vada' dig at BJP over 'skyrocketing' prices of food items
content: Congress targets PM Modi over rising food prices, inflation . he says rising prices are making pulses and other essential food items difficult for poorer households to afford . "the people go hungry, the government stays silent," he said .

title: Space rocks reveal how early solar system separated rock from ice-rich dust
content: heat-forged chondrules make up between 83% and 92% of composition . aerodynamic sorting separated rocky grains from fine matrix containing water ice and organic molecules, leaving the first planetesimals unusually poor in volatile-rich dust .

title: IIT-B hostel awaits replacement of ceiling fans promised in July after student's death
content: the replacement was among the measures the institute had assured students it would undertake in July . it followed the death by suicide of another student . this comes amid an ongoing row over the death of 20-year-old student Sahil Wakode on the institute campus .

title: ‘Travel to Coimbatore, Madurai’: Annamalai takes swipe at Vijay’s UK trip
content: former Tamil Nadu BJP president criticises chief minister and TVK leader . he says the state government should instead focus on encouraging local industries to expand and invest . the remarks come as DMK president MK Stalin also criticise Vijay’s recent visit to London .

title: Palm Beach mansion near Mar-a-Lago lists for $59 million
content: the 0.8-acre estate at 111 Via Del Lago has eight bedrooms, 10 bathrooms, a six-car garage and a two-story cabana . it is designed in the 1920s by the same name behind mar-a-Lago and the Norton Museum of Art . developer Todd Michael Glaser, who first bought the home in 2018, renovated it, sold it, then repurchased it in 2022 .

title: ‘Our generation was mentally strong’: Congress leader on IIT-B suicide case
content: the student, from IIT Bombay’s Department of Energy Science and Engineering, allegedly died by suicide on friday evening after he was found using a mobile phone during a mid-semester examination . the case has been transferred to the Crime Branch after the student’s father filed a complaint alleging that the professor and exam invigilator Suryanarayana Doolla hurled casteist slurs at his son .

title: High number of SIR notices result of rule change after Bihar experience
content: EC revised the rules in Phase 2 covering 12 states/UTs . the rules required electors to attach documents proving their eligibility to be included in the roll . over a dozen documents were listed as acceptable proof of birth, citizenship and residence at the enumeration stage itself .
